# Government of Bihar

> Official state portal for Bihar government providing comprehensive information on governance, policies, schemes, and citizen services across multiple departments.

The Bihar government website serves as the primary digital interface for state administration, featuring key initiatives like the 7 Nishchay program, alcohol prohibition policy, and panchayatiraj governance. It provides citizens with access to various departments, official communications, and state development information.

## Key Topics

- Bihar Government
- Nitish Kumar
- 7 Nishchay
- Governance
- State Schemes
- Panchayatiraj
- Alcohol Prohibition
- Women Reservation
- State Statistics
- Government Departments
- Cabinet Secretariat
- Home Department
- Disaster Management
- Law Department
- Citizen Services

## Core Government Portal

- [Government of Bihar Home](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/CitizenHome.html): Official Bihar Government portal with state profile, governance structure, and citizen information.
- [About Bihar Government](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/CitizenAboutUs.html): About Bihar Government with state profile, history, and administrative overview.
- [Government Dashboard](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/DashBoard.html): Government dashboard with state statistics, schemes, and policy highlights.
- [Main Content Portal](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/Content.html): Main content portal for Bihar Government policies and schemes.

## Major Government Departments

- [Home Department](https://state.bihar.gov.in/home): Home Department Bihar managing law, order and police administration.
- [Cabinet Secretariat Department](https://state.bihar.gov.in/csd): Cabinet Secretariat Department with administrative structure and contacts.
- [General Administration Department](https://state.bihar.gov.in/gad): General Administration Department handling personnel and civil services.
- [Law Department](https://state.bihar.gov.in/law): Law Department Bihar handling legal services and legislative drafting.
- [Disaster Management Department](https://state.bihar.gov.in/disastermgmt): Disaster Management Department for relief, mitigation and preparedness.
- [Information and Public Relations Department](https://state.bihar.gov.in/prdbihar): IPRD Bihar disseminating government policies and public communications.

## Government Information & Reference

- [Department Information](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/SectionInformation.html): Detailed information on government departments and sections.
- [Infrastructure](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/Infrastructure.html): Bihar state infrastructure and development initiatives overview.

## Citizen Support & Services

- [Contact Us](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/CitizenContactUs.html): Contact information for Bihar Government departments and officials.
- [Phone Directory](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/PhoneDirectory.html): Phone directory for Bihar Government officials and departments.
- [FAQ](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/CitizenFAQ.html): Frequently asked questions about Bihar Government services and policies.
- [Newsletter Subscription](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/NewsLetterSubscription.html): Newsletter subscription page for Bihar Government news and updates.

## Optional Resources

- [Accessibility](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/Accessibility.html): Website accessibility information and guidelines for users.
- [Site Map](https://state.bihar.gov.in/main/sitemap.html): Website sitemap for navigation and site structure overview.
